label: Research half of #515: the first two global-underminer instances of one retorsion schema
summary: Research half of #515: the first two global-underminer instances of one retorsion schema. Schema: #516's performed-denial retorsion (LOGIC-PERFORMED-DENIAL-RETORSION); #515 adds only the presupposition link (TruthCore.Alternatives.Retorsion.PresuppositionLink: every performance is, through a token, an occurring episode of the denied sort). Superseded approach: a separate typed Underminer schema module written before #516 merged; dropped to avoid a competing schema, since #516's theorem is its special case once the link is an instance hypothesis. Eleatic instance: episodes are being-respect pairs occurring when the being is moved in that respect; the token of an opining is the opiner in the respect of the opinion; the link is definitionally OpiningIsBeingMovedReading (eleatic_link_iff). Registered instance_of_schema; the instance's Comparator config lists both its theorem and noAccurateDenial, whose Solution its Challenge imports. ELEATIC-THESIS-SELF-REFUTING is unchanged: re-proving it through a schema lemma failed Comparator ('challenge and solution theorem statements do not match'), because its frozen Challenge imports only ActPotencyRegress; adding only the import passed. McTaggart: one bounded attempt; he escapes at the link, not the logic: his § 511 answer (ATTEMPT-MCTAGGART-NOE-II-RETORSION-REPLY) denies the change link outright and, with the open bridge STMT-MOTION-IS-A-CHANGE, the Eleatic link; the opinionGate model satisfies his 1908 bundle, the 1927 answer, the bridge and both held theses while both links fail; #516's StaticEpisodeControl is included. Rejected: registering McTaggart as instance_of_schema (the instance fails) and a refutes relation for the Eleatic instance (its link is open, #391). Frontier delta: none.
